input_law: all 1,722 ordered distinct nonidentity pairs on fixed E(F_47): y^2=x^3-x-2, order 43, centered coordinate lifts
coefficient_rule: for distinct centered x, a1,a2,a3=47*(k1,k2,k3), each ki in [-K,K] integers; solve a4,a6 exactly from the two point equations
order: scan [-2,2]^3 lexicographically; select the first passing choice separately within each nested budget and gate arm
same_x: 42 pairs with equal centered x have no uniquely solved a4,a6 and remain explicit zero-choice rows

gates.7: integral coefficients, good reduction, point-incidence rank 2, #E(F_7)=4
gates.11_strict: integral coefficients, good reduction, point-incidence rank 2, #E(F_11)=6
gates.11_weak: integral coefficients, good reduction, point-incidence rank 2, #E(F_11)=7

relation: source reduced P1+2P2 flag; rational and both local point sums for every selected candidate
record: all 1,722 per-pair rows with both budget status counts and first selections; gzip with exact raw SHA-256 and candidate-stream digest
run_cap: complete 210,000 maximum-budget candidates; no wall-time performance claim
control: K=1 rows and selections must exactly replay the prior full-law result
